structDirectedEdge {
    int dst;

};

const int BOUND = 10010;

vector<int> gr[BOUND];
lli dis[BOUND];
int par[BOUND], edgeid[BOUND];
bool inq[BOUND];

int N, M, K, COST_PER_DAY, PER_UNIT_COST;

lli overallCost = 0;

void connect(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
    int idx = edges.size();
    edges.push_back({to, cap, 0, cost});
    gr[from].push_back(idx);
    edges.push_back({from, 0, 0, -cost});
    gr[to].push_back(idx + 1);
}

void executeShortestPath() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 10000; ++i) {
        dis[i] = 1e18;
        par[i] = -1;
        edgeid[i] = -1;
        inq[i] = false;
    }
    queue<int> qu;
    dis[src] = 0;
    qu.push(src);
    inq[src] = true;

    while (!qu.empty()) {
        int u = qu.front(); qu.pop();
        inq[u] = false;
        for (int eid : gr[u]) {
            auto& e = edges[eid];
            if (e.cur_flow >= e.cap) continue;
            lli nd = dis[u] + e.w;
            if (nd < dis[e.dst]) {
                dis[e.dst] = nd;
                par[e.dst] = u;
                edgeid[e.dst] = eid;
                if (!inq[e.dst]) {
                    inq[e.dst] = true;
                    qu.push(e.dst);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (dis[dst] >= 1e18) return;

    int v = dst;
    while (v != src) {
        int id = edgeid[v];
        edges[id].cur_flow++;
        edges[id ^ 1].cur_flow--;
        v = par[v];
    }
    overallCost += dis[dst];
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> N >> M >> K >> COST_PER_DAY >> PER_UNIT_COST;

    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        int u; cin >> u; --u;
        connect(src, u, 1, 0);
    }

    for (int layer = 1; layer <= 101; ++layer) {
        connect((layer - 1) * N, dst, K, (layer - 1) * COST_PER_DAY);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        int u, v; cin >> u >> v; --u; --v;
        for (int lvl = 1; lvl <= 100; ++lvl) {
            for (int rep = 1; rep <= K; ++rep) {
                int weight = PER_UNIT_COST * ((rep - 1) * 2 + 1);
                connect(u + (lvl - 1) * N, v + (lvl - 1) * N + N, 1, weight);
                connect(v + (lvl - 1) * N, u + (lvl - 1) * N + N, 1, weight);

        for (int lvl = 1; lvl <= 100; ++lvl) {
